title: Wellstorm!
author: HawthorneTR
selftext:
Hey everyone,

Just wanted to share a procedural project I finished called Wellstorm. It's an arcade score-attack game modeled after classic vector tube shooters. 

Everything you see and hear is handled via real-time code loops:

\* Infinite procedurally morphing tubes, canyons, and rifts.

\* Generative neon wireframes, custom phosphor trail math, and simulated CRT curvature.

\* Dynamic synthesized soundtracks and audio effects generated algorithmically on the fly. 

As a solo developer, I leveraged AI tools heavily to write and refine the backend math, matrix transformations, and optimization formulas required to draw these complex shapes smoothly. Because I disclosed the AI coding assistance on [Itch.io](http://Itch.io), the algorithm hides it from general browse tabs, so I'm sharing the build here with people who enjoy procedural systems.

The Windows build is live and lightweight (33MB). I’d love to get your feedback on the seed variation, the procedural scaling difficulty, and the dynamic audio pacing. 

Check it out here: [https://hawthornetr.itch.io/wellstorm](https://hawthornetr.itch.io/wellstorm)
